# nexus piholezone get

List DNS zones, or with NAME, get a DNS zone

Without NAME: Lists the DNS zones declared, by Nexus zone markers, in Pi-hole's local DNS records file (providers.pihole.dnsFile), sorted by name, with each zone's record count and the file's etag, for ifMatch. A record belongs to the declared zone that is the longest suffix of its name; unzoned records are not a zone. Read-only: reads the file only. Fails dependency-unavailable when the file is unreadable or larger than 1 MiB.

With NAME: Returns one declared DNS zone by its FQDN, with its record count and the DNS file's etag. An undeclared zone answers 404 not-found. Read-only: reads the file only. Fails dependency-unavailable when the file is unreadable or larger than 1 MiB.

## Usage

```
nexus piholezone get [NAME] [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # List DNS zones
  nexus piholezone get
  # Get a DNS zone
  nexus piholezone get <name>
```

## Flags

```
      --filter stringArray   key=value, repeatable: print only objects whose dot path has this value; a repeated key matches any of its values
  -h, --help                 help for get
  -o, --output string        output format: table, json, jsonl, yaml (default table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise)
      --select strings       print only these dot paths of each object, comma-separated, such as name,properties.state; host and id are always kept
      --stdin                read JSON Lines objects from stdin, such as another command's output, and run once per line: each binds its host and its id or name; a line without host uses the target host
      --stop-on-error        with --stdin, stop at the first line that fails
      --tag strings          target every configured host with this tag; comma-separated or repeated for any of several
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
